5598.title: Parent resolution uses a thread-wide access path
5598.rootCauseOneLine: The multi-ID parent lookup chooses the sequence index with only thread_id constrained, rather than seeking item IDs in the existing partial index.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — Targets the reproduced access-path defect
prReviews.topFinding: The open draft PR explicitly closes #5598; its code was not executed and no duplicate fix was opened.

5598.proposedFix: Require the existing delegating-item index while preserving the SQL row projection, filters, output cap, and sequence order. Existing open PR #5599 covers this path.
5598.caveats: Same agent repeated the regression in two fresh trusted clones. Exact released-app latency and large matching-ID workloads were not measured. All repro code is inline per the reports repository publication policy.
